idh.reasoning: The tumor is entirely non-enhancing with no necrotic components, as indicated by an Enhancement Quality of 'None', zero enhancing tumor volume, and zero necrotic volume. This presentation, particularly in a solitary, cortically-based frontal lobe lesion, is highly characteristic of an IDH-mutant glioma. IDH-wildtype gliomas (glioblastomas) typically exhibit significant enhancement and necrosis, both of which are absent here. The lack of deep white matter invasion further supports a less aggressive, IDH-mutant phenotype.
